[1/4] Plan: treat context as a fit parameter, not a quality search; smallest covering size from the selected tasks

impact_assessment.why: Code prompts are short; 4k/16k tie in quality, while context grows the KV cache ~30 MB per 1k tokens.

impact_assessment.risks: contract: quality-stage load choice; dependency: memory-fit; concurrency: none; state: profiles
impact_assessment.mitigation: unit tests, real code quality run, full suite, tune:gate

[1/1] Plan: add opt-in --full-final so the tuner scores each final preset on every task item (136 for code) instead of the 48-item search rung; keep the fast rung the default

impact_assessment.why: The 48-item search rung is a sample of the task; a final preset deserves a full-item rate so the reported score is not only a subsample.
impact_assessment.benefits: Higher-power final rate; withDiscriminatingRungs can expose the full item set without changing the default run cost.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: tune CLI and task rungs; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: benchmark suite version unchanged
impact_assessment.mitigation: default stays the fast rung; real-engine validation on one preset; hermetic tests; tune gate on the three core models

[1/1] Plan: measure the 21 abstract-thinking prompt family against the current best code prompt on qwen2.5-coder-1.5b-instruct-q4, paired on the 48-item rung, then full 136 items for the best arm; include reasoning auto/deep arms

impact_assessment.why: ADR-036 retired the thinking prompts on an underpowered first tune and the last deep-reasoning run lost at 12-37 answers; the current question is whether an abstract-thinking instruction can raise code-task performance with the v8 profile and a powered pair.
impact_assessment.benefits: A pre-registered paired verdict (McNemar) instead of slogan prompts being assumed useless; if an arm wins, it becomes a tuner prompt candidate.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: tuner prompt step list; dependency: real engine + model file; concurrency: measurement must not share the box with Crucible scoring; state: scratch harness only, no tracked code until a win
impact_assessment.mitigation: wait for the WSP6 scorer to exit, fixed load/sampling from the saved profile, same rung for every arm, paired exact test, full-rung confirmation before any default change
